notes.title: 1.1.1 Patch
notes.content:
[p]Hi! 

Small patch that adds support for keyboard controls [b]when a gamepad is connected.[/b]
This should hopefully alleviate a little bit of friction when playing with a steam deck docked.
[i](A second gamepad would also work!)[/i] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119160/b44174406662e775081f315297261e8d0b813dab.png"][/img]
[b][u]
Keyboard[/u][/b][u] [b]controls are as usual[/b][/u][/p][p]Arrow keys
Primary button: [b]z/c[/b]
Secondary: [b]x/v[/b]
End turn: [b]Space[/b][i]

/ Sebastian[/i][/p]

notes.title: 1.1.0 Tricky update
notes.content:
[p][b]Hi![/b] 


With this update I wanted to create some levels with the [b]Pull[/b] [b]card[/b] that gets introduced in the endless mode.
Expect some tricky levels where you need to use all the tricks on your arsenal to finish all of them! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119160/31dc90507056ecb95cb688fb581e42755543d533.png"][/img][/p][p]I also introduced a new [b]"sneak peek"[/b] mechanic. 
You can now see your upcoming turns by hovering over your deck. 
This is especially handy in the [b]Tricky and the Endless mode!
[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45119160/c7e8a072abf512ee9f6c161a17d078250ad8ef15.png"][/img][b]
Hope you have fun and stay awesome!
[/b][i]
/ Sebastian[/i][/p]
